issue_context.title: Please make the tiles in Dashboard clickable, so that clicking them takes me to settings page of that feature.
issue_context.body: ### Description of the new feature / enhancement The new Dashboard page has quick access for enabling modules, short descriptions and activation methods. All individual tiles have enable/disable switches, and whichever module don't have keyboard shortcut for activation, they have a "launch" button in these tiles. My feature request is - make each of the module tiles clickable. So that when I click any of the tiles, it takes me to that module's full settings page. For example, when I click the "Text Extractor" tile, it should take me to "Text Extractor" module's setting page. ### Scenario when this would be used? I saw that "Shortcut Guide" has activation key of "Win+Shift+/". I want to change that to some other key combo. Instead of me find that module in the left sidebar and clicking it, it'd be a little bit easier to click the tile I'm already looking at. (btw, sidenote - this particular module tile is showing wrong activation method. My "Shortcut Guide" activation is set to "hold down windows key", but dashboard is showing "Win+Shift+/". But I digress.) ### Supporting information _No response_

Yes, we had settingspage buttons but at the end we have removed them to have a clearer view of switched on modules.

> Yes, we had settingspage buttons but at the end we have removed them to have a clearer view of switched on modules.

Yep, not adding a separate "settings" button to each of the tiles keeps it clean. But can we make the tiles themselves a button to open their corresponding settings? UI will look same as how it does now. Only difference being clicking the tiles will open their settings.
